title: Nvidia warns: Lack of computing power threatens Europe’s competitiveness in artificial intelligence
hook_text: Europe faces an AI computing crisis
script:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang warns Europe risks falling behind in AI.
The United States currently controls seventy-five percent of global AI computing power.
Europe sits at only five percent of that vital capacity.
Huang says this lack of local power threatens industrial competitiveness.
Nvidia emphasizes that sovereign AI infrastructure is now a strategic necessity.
Without local data centers, European companies may rely entirely on external systems.
Can Europe build enough local capacity to stay independent?
